def preprocess_for_classical(text: str) -> str:
    '''Lightweight deterministic preprocessing for TF-IDF classical models.

    Substitutions applied in order:
      1. Lowercase    -> uniform case for vocabulary matching
      2. URLs         -> [URL]    (removes domain-specific features the on-device
                                   URL Intelligence Engine handles separately)
      3. Phone numbers -> [PHONE] (PII scrubbing + reduces OOV token diversity)
      4. Amounts      -> [AMOUNT] (normalises monetary figures across fraud types)
      5. Whitespace   -> single spaces, stripped

    Lowercase is applied first so that substitution tokens ([URL], [PHONE],
    [AMOUNT]) are inserted into already-lowercased text and remain in their
    canonical uppercase form — distinguishable from ordinary vocabulary tokens.
    The original message is never overwritten — callers receive a new string.
    '''
    text = text.lower()
    text = _RE_URL.sub("[URL]", text)
    text = _RE_PHONE.sub("[PHONE]", text)
    text = _RE_AMOUNT.sub("[AMOUNT]", text)
    text = _RE_WS.sub(" ", text).strip()
    return text
